For VideoAI production work, read AGENTS.md, PRODUCTION_RULES.md and videoai_policy/policy.json. Apply the shared policy regardless of model. Export instructions with `python policy_tool.py prompt`; validate a concrete production_review with `python policy_tool.py check <plan.json>`. Explicit user requests take precedence. Inspect actual media before delivery; plan validation is not a guarantee of quality or views. Civic, election and policy explainers use politics mode (`--mode politics`; see the Politics mode section of PRODUCTION_RULES.md).
